Subject: POC success criteria & next steps (MedBase)

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the context on MedBase's downstream latency and inference cost targets. Per our call, attaching a short success-criteria workbook to align on what "pass" looks like for the POC. Key points here: 

- Success criteria (high level): average 95th-percentile latency < 350ms for interactive workflows, p90 cost-per-1000-tokens under $X (we'll refine with model selection), and zero PII leakage in sample prompts.
- Evaluation plan: 2-week trial against representative traffic (we'll provide SDK + test harness), with daily ingest of a 500-record prompt set and weekly automated regression checks.
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood) — overall trial lead; Marcus (Redwood) — infra/perf; Rishi (Redwood) — quality metrics and evals. MedBase owners: Sarah (product) and Eldon (platform).
- Timeline: proposed kickoff Aug 17, 2-week run, final readout week of Aug 31 (you mentioned an executive review on your side — ideally schedule the readout + decision meeting for the week of Aug 31).

Please confirm the criteria & timeline. I attached "medbase_poc_success_criteria.xlsx" with a more detailed checklist (fields for data sets, sample prompts, and go/no-go gates). Once you confirm, we'll send a short test harness and a proposed test dataset.
